lines: This lake makes its own thunderstorms. Every single night.
This lake makes its OWN THUNDERSTORMS. Every single NIGHT.
Welcome to How On Earth Weather! Joseph is live at Lake Victoria.
Welcome to HOW ON EARTH WEATHER! Joseph is LIVE at LAKE VICTORIA.
Africa's biggest lake. Bigger than Lake Michigan... and moodier.
AFRICA'S BIGGEST lake. Bigger than LAKE MICHIGAN... and MOODIER.
Here's the trick. By day, the land heats up faster, so storms pop up over land.
Here's the TRICK. By DAY, the LAND heats up FASTER, so STORMS pop up over LAND.
[laughs] Perfect! So I just stay on the beach?
PERFECT! So I just stay on the BEACH?
Until night. The land cools off, but the lake stays warm.
Until NIGHT. The LAND cools off, but the LAKE stays WARM.
Breezes from every shore crash together over the water... and up it goes.
BREEZES from EVERY SHORE CRASH together over the WATER... and UP it goes.
[surprised] The whole coastline ganging up on one lake?!
The WHOLE COASTLINE ganging up on ONE LAKE?!
Every night. And the extended forecast... clouds of flies.
EVERY night. And the extended FORECAST... CLOUDS of FLIES.
Lake flies. Billions of them, in swarms you can see from miles away.
LAKE FLIES. BILLIONS of them, in SWARMS you can see from MILES away.
[sarcastic] Fantastic. Cloudy... with a chance of flies.
FANTASTIC. CLOUDY... with a CHANCE of FLIES.
Could be worse. Seventeen thousand years ago, this lake was completely dry.
Could be WORSE. 17 THOUSAND YEARS ago, this lake was COMPLETELY DRY.
Gone, for over two thousand years. Then the rain came back.
GONE, for over TWO THOUSAND YEARS. Then the RAIN came BACK.
[laughs] So it's basically a giant puddle!
So it's basically a GIANT PUDDLE!
Kind of! At its deepest, the Statue of Liberty's torch would stick out.
Kind of! At its DEEPEST, the STATUE OF LIBERTY'S TORCH would STICK OUT.
All that water leaves in Uganda... to start the Nile.
All that WATER leaves in UGANDA... to start the NILE.
So the Nile starts... next to my storm. [sighs] Let me guess tomorrow's forecast...
So the NILE starts... next to MY STORM. Let me GUESS tomorrow's FORECAST...
